Make in the DfT vehicle licensing statistics naming (VEH0220 / VEH0124), upper case; makes DfT spells two ways are merged (inputs/make_aliases.csv). The raw make, upper-cased, where it matches no DfT make; NA where it is a placeholder such as UNKNOWN
DfT generic model without the make ("C CLASS", "FIESTA"); the normalised raw model where it matches no DfT generic model (then dft_genmodel is NA); NA where the model is a placeholder
The rest of the raw DVSA model text after the words that give the model (trim, engine, body style), upper case, not standardised
DfT body type: Cars, Light goods vehicles, Motorcycles, Buses and coaches, Heavy goods vehicles or Other vehicles (see body_type_src)
DfT GenModel of make_final + model_final, for joining to DfT tables (NA when model_final is not a DfT generic model)
DfT model string, when the raw DVSA model is exactly one

How make_final was found: exact, punctuation, alias, dvla (the raw make's vehicles mostly have that DVLA make), prefix, fuzzy (spelling fix), dvla_vehicle (this vehicle's DVLA make, for a missing or unmatched DVSA make), override, placeholder or unmatched

How model_final was found: exact (a DfT model string), generic (a DfT generic model name), prefix, words, fuzzy (spelling fix), ambiguous / make_only (chosen per vehicle from fuel, engine size and year of first use), override, placeholder or unmatched
Share of the DfT vehicles under the matched text that have this generic model; for ambiguous / make_only, the chosen model's share of the per-vehicle weight

Source of body_type: model (the DfT model string's body type), type_approval (DVLA type approval, where the generic model has that body type), genmodel (the generic model's most common body type) or test_class

Fuel type: DVSA; DVLA (same vehicle only, mapped to DVSA terms) where DVSA is 'Other', or says Electric/Fuel Cells for a DVLA vehicle with an engine; fuel of same-engine vehicles for an Electric/Fuel Cells vehicle with a recorded engine size; Electric where the make/model check corrects it. Never backfilled
Source of fuel: dvsa, dvla, variant (most common fuel of the same make/model/birth year/engine size), model (set to Electric by the make/model check) or dft (replaced by the DfT plug-in hybrid value)
Fuel compared with the same make/model: ok, rare_conversion, rare_for_model, implausible_for_model, corrected_electric, unknown_fuel or no_reference (see methodology.md)
Fuel grouped as Petrol / Diesel / Electric / Hybrid Electric / Plug-in Hybrid Electric / Other

Fuel as the DfT vehicle licensing statistics record it for this make and model (VEH0220), which unlike DVSA and DVLA separates plug-in hybrids from other hybrids. NA where the make/model has no DfT vehicles of this fuel group, or where no one DfT fuel is common enough to choose (see fuel_DFT_src)

How fuel_DFT was found: dft_model (the DfT model string's most common fuel of this group), dft_genmodel (the generic model's), ambiguous_model / ambiguous_genmodel (a match, but no single DfT fuel reaches the checks.dft_fuel_share threshold) or no_reference
Engine size (cc): DVSA if > 0, else DVLA if > 0 (same vehicle only); 0 for Electric and Fuel Cells; else most common for the same make/model/birth year/fuel, then make/model/fuel
Source of engine_cc: dvsa, dvla, no_engine (Electric / Fuel Cells), model_year_fuel or model_fuel

Engine size check: ok; engine_removed (Electric / Fuel Cells vehicle with a recorded engine size, set to 0); zero_replaced (fuel with an engine recorded as 0cc, backfilled); missing (fuel with an engine and no engine size after backfill)
Revenue weight (kg): DVLA, else variant backfill
Source of the matching harmonised column: dvsa or dvla (recorded), variant (same make/model/birth year/fuel/engine size) or model_year_fuel (same make/model/birth year/fuel)

CO2 emissions (g/km): DVLA, else variant backfill. A recorded 0 is kept only for Electric and Fuel Cells vehicles; for anything else it is impossible, so it is cleared before the backfill and the vehicle is filled from similar vehicles (see co2_check)
Source of the matching harmonised column: dvsa or dvla (recorded), variant (same make/model/birth year/fuel/engine size) or model_year_fuel (same make/model/birth year/fuel)

CO2 check: ok; zero_replaced (a recorded 0 g/km on a vehicle with an engine, backfilled from similar vehicles); zero_removed (the same, but no backfill value was available); missing (no CO2 recorded or backfilled)

Euro status: DVLA with the spelling standardised ('EURO 6AP' and 'EURO6 (AP)' become 'EURO 6 AP'; see R/euro_status.R), else variant backfill, else the standard that was compulsory for new registrations of that body type when the vehicle was made

Source of euro_status: dvla (recorded), variant or model_year_fuel (backfilled from similar vehicles), or euro_schedule (the standard that was compulsory for new registrations of that body type when the vehicle was made)
Euro emission standard number parsed from euro_status (Roman numerals converted)

Euro status against the vehicle's age: ok; later_than_date (the recorded or backfilled status names a standard that did not exist when the vehicle was made - kept, not changed); assumed (filled from the registration-date schedule); pre_euro (made before the first standard of its class); no_schedule (body type with no schedule: Other vehicles, or none); no_date
Type approval category: DVLA, else variant backfill
Source of the matching harmonised column: dvsa or dvla (recorded), variant (same make/model/birth year/fuel/engine size) or model_year_fuel (same make/model/birth year/fuel)
